properties.name: state
properties.comment: Whether the lamp is off, on or showing an error. The lens warms up on a change to on or error and cools down on a change to off, at once under reduced motion.

table.description: Whether the lamp is off, on or showing an error.

hand: written starts the lens's warm-up or cool-down (IndicatorLamp::begin_change) besides the paint and semantics invalidation

properties.name: text
properties.comment: The legend beside the lens, which also names the lamp to assistive technology; empty for a lens alone. Must be valid UTF-8 (std::invalid_argument).
prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("IndicatorLamp text must be valid UTF-8");

properties.name: light_planes
properties.comment: The baked light planes the lens is composited from, by name: a bake in the windows' light-plane directory (ApplicationResources::set_light_plane_directory), 1 to 64 lower-case letters, digits and '_', or empty for the theme's lens (std::invalid_argument otherwise). With the bake present the lens takes its aspect and whole look, its body included, and the bezel gives way; without it, and in forced high contrast, the theme's lens is drawn.

table.description: The baked light planes the lens is composited from, by name.

prepare: throw std::invalid_argument("IndicatorLamp light_planes must name a bake: lower-case letters, digits and '_'");

properties.name: lamp_color
properties.comment: The colour the lens lights in while on, as sRGB, or empty for the theme's. With a bake it is the bake's lamp light at unit power (one bake serves every colour), lamp amber when empty; without one it fills the lit lens over the theme's look, as an authored colour, so not in forced high contrast. An error always lights in the error colour (with a bake, lamp red).

table.description: The colour the lens lights in while on.
